text: {"label":"Matching-to-Sample Procedures and Mediation","definition":"Research on matching-to-sample procedures, including delayed matching, how trials and stimuli are arranged, observing and precurrent responses, and whether covert verbal mediation or rehearsal supports accurate responding and emergent relations.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers on the matching-to-sample task itself and its procedural variants, unlike the matching law of choice, general conditional discrimination training, or conceptual work on equivalence class formation."}
